payload.originalSection:
## Delivery Budget

- Estimate confidence: medium

| ID | Work item | Effort | Architecture delta | Debt claim | Addresses | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| W1 | Read-only live/archived input resolution and diagnostics | 3 | 1 | - | - | Crosses command context, record/progress and mapped config seams; adds one read-only resolver including archived ID lookup and side-effect tests. |
| W2 | Canonical as-of effective state, ordering and event identity | 5 | 1 | - | - | New cross-stream boundary abstraction with shared routing extraction; acceptance, supersession, corruption and concurrency tests included. |
| W3 | Inspection model, evidence register, differences and pagination | 5 | 2 | - | - | New exported view contract and historical projection spanning ledger/findings/claims; carries missing-data provenance and stable page semantics. |
| W4 | Dedicated safe terminal renderers | 3 | 1 | - | - | Show/history and verbose evidence presentation with Unicode width/control safety, tested as pure string functions. |
| W5 | CLI adapters, discovery and plan-domain release integration | 3 | 0 | - | - | Existing command/output/export/docs seams; subprocess acceptance and no-write regressions belong to this item. |
| W6 | Read-only adapter to implemented 210 domain contracts | 3 | 1 | - | - | Cross-domain consumer mapping and combined-release tests; depends on 210 supplying binding/realization/decision authority, not a new policy engine here. |

No negative architecture deltas or debt claims are proposed. Tests are part of their owning implementation work item; prerequisite verification and documentation are included in the corresponding phase, not separate scored items.

### Surface Snapshot

- Subsystems: 4
- Production files: 13
- Persistent/external boundaries: 2
- New shared abstractions: 2
- New persistent schemas: 0

Subsystems: command integration, record/progress resolution, governance projection, and inspection model/presentation. Boundaries: existing run record streams (read-only) and existing Git-backed archived reads. Abstractions: immutable ordered read set and shared inspection view model. Thirteen production files are enumerated below; no source changes to 210's binding/realization writers are counted or authorized.

findings.title: Phase 6/W6 depends on unimplemented plan 210 but is in this plan's scored sequential scope
findings.failure: A phase-sequential implementation run reaches Phase 6 after Phase 5 and stalls (cannot complete the plan) or requires an ad-hoc mid-run human gate; W6 points/architecture burden in the baseline are unverifiable.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Move Phase 6/W6 to a follow-up plan triggered by 210 integration, keeping Phase 5's BUDGET_INSPECTION_UNSUPPORTED guard as the forward-compatibility contract; or add an explicit orchestrator-visible deferral condition and its budget treatment.

findings.title: No canonical per-snapshot budget reconstruction; routeAfterDecision requires nullable snapshot.derived
findings.failure: Inspection of archived or index-wiped runs throws or reconstructs requiresHuman/alerts that differ from the recorded decoration, breaking the plan's wiped-index parity acceptance and the no-copied-formulas requirement.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: In Phase 2, name one shared pure helper building recorded-review budget inputs (baseline, snapshot prefix, paired verdict semanticHumanRequired, as-of governing B, first baselineAssessment I, configSnapshot); make the effective-state helper take an explicit base budget; keep routeAfterDecision as a behavior-preserving wrapper; add a null-derived parity test; update Files Touched/Surface Snapshot.

findings.title: Linear single-pass fold gate conflicts with existing per-decision rescanning acceptance/fold helpers
findings.failure: Implementer either fails the long-history operation-count completion gate or reimplements decision acceptance privately, creating a second policy engine.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Specify extracting classify/fold variants that accept a pre-decoded snapshot index and precomputed step positions (acceptance is prefix-invariant once the human step is included), keep existing exports as parity-tested wrappers, fold incrementally in one ordered pass, and add decisions.ts to Files Touched.

baselineAssessment.reason: W1-W5 plausible at ~19 with W1 slightly light (exact-run archived extraction/discovery); P1.2/P1.3 shared-helper extractions add ~1 each; W6 is estimated against unimplemented 210 interfaces and is likely light.
